proposal.summary: Batch L4 is 17 CM848 functions named by an old automatic pass that called anything near a limit 'protection'. None of them is an engine protection. Four are executive frame task sets, named here by schedule slot the way CM550's sets were named in round 93. Three set points of the J1939 PGN 65251 engine configuration torque curve. Two belong to the fuel derate chain: the chain itself and the step that turns the torque limit into a fuel limit. One computes the percent load on the low horsepower curve. Six are power-up initializers (4D timing caches, misfire timing limit, governor tuning blend weight, fuel pressure governor fault blend, engine retarder TSC1 state, switch inputs). The last is an unreachable store in the transmission type 3 branch of torque management. Each name rests on the outputs of its own body, checked by disassembly, by e2m records resolved through the ECU's parameter ID table and by the RAM dump. No CM550 twin is proven: 0x4280c, 0x1e4e8 and 0x50e000 are counterparts of CM550 0x30c3c, 0x1c0d4 and 0x26e2c.

cm848_functions.role: Executive frame task set that runs the torque management pass, the cruise control periodic update and the fuel metering battery voltage filter once every 8 frames.
cm848_functions.discriminator: Its schedule slot: it is the only set called as call 4 of frames 2, 10, 18, 26 and 34 (the 8-frame slot, phase 2). Its three tasks have no shared role: the torque management fuel limit, the cruise control state and the battery voltage filter of the fuel metering PWM.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Executive frame task set: runs every 8 frames (40 ms), at frames 2, 10, 18, 26 and 34 of the 40-frame cycle, as call 4 of those frames in executiveFrameInterruptHandler. Calls, in order: cm848_runTorqueManagement, cm848_cruiseControlPeriodicUpdate, cm848_filterEngineSensorValue (was cm848_periodicTaskSet_protection; named by slot like CM550's cm550_runEvery<N>FramesTaskSetPhase<M> sets).
cm848_functions.evidence: executiveFrameInterruptHandler 0xc0a0 has a jump table at 0xc198-0xc234 (40 cases). bl 0xbb68 is at 0xc29c (frame 2), 0xc3b4 (10), 0xc4d8 (18), 0xc5f0 (26) and 0xc6f8 (34), each the 4th bl of its case after 0xb76c / 0xb7b4 / 0xba08. No other bl to 0xbb68 and no pointer to it in ROM or flash2. Body: bl 0x3f2b0 (0xbb74), bl 0x512ff4 (0xbb78), bl 0x4922c (0xbb7c). cm848_filterEngineSensorValue filters battery_voltage_sensor_channel_state.value into fuel_pressure_governor_state.filtered_battery_voltage. A frame is one PIT period: PITC = 4999, and the advanceHourMeters plate says '40 PIT ticks of 5 ms'. CM848 has no 'runEvery' names. Its CM550 slot sibling cm550_runEvery8FramesTaskSetPhase2 (0x1b678) calls 0x449f4 / 0x451fa, which are not dumped, so no twin can be proven.

cm848_functions.role: Executive frame task set that starts the periodic EEPROM block read (the EEPROM mirror reload) once every 10 frames.
cm848_functions.discriminator: Its schedule slot: it is the only set called as call 5 of frames 4, 14, 24 and 34 (the 10-frame slot, phase 4). Its only task is cm848_startEepromBlockRead. It is named by slot like CM550's single-task sets (cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase5 runs only cm550_runLampControl).
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Executive frame task set: runs every 10 frames (50 ms), at frames 4, 14, 24 and 34 of the 40-frame cycle, as call 5 of those frames in executiveFrameInterruptHandler. Calls only cm848_startEepromBlockRead, the periodic EEPROM mirror reload: one 30-word block per call, copied in by cm848_onEepromBlockRead (was cm848_periodicTaskSet_protection2).
cm848_functions.evidence: bl 0xbce8 is at 0xc2ec (frame 4), 0xc448 (14), 0xc5ac (24) and 0xc6fc (34), each the 5th bl of its case. No other reference. Body: bl 0x4bd5c (0xbcf4) only. cm848_startEepromBlockRead: when eeprom_driver_operation is 0 it sets it to 1 and builds command 3 (READ) at eeprom_mirror_load_offset with word_count 0x20 and completion_callback cm848_onEepromBlockRead, then calls cm848_queueQspiJob. The cm848_refreshRamCalibration plate calls this the EEPROM side of the RAM refresh.

cm848_functions.role: Executive frame task set that runs the charging voltage target, the charging system voltage monitor, the fuel pressure fault reaction requests and the fuel limits for fuel pressure faults once every 20 frames.
cm848_functions.discriminator: Its schedule slot: it is the only set called as call 5 of frames 8 and 28 (the 20-frame slot, phase 8; frames 8 and 28 have no 10-frame call). It does two unrelated jobs: the alternator charging voltage, and the reactions to fuel pressure faults.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Executive frame task set: runs every 20 frames (100 ms), at frames 8 and 28 of the 40-frame cycle, as call 5 of those frames in executiveFrameInterruptHandler (the 10-frame slot is empty there). Calls, in order: cm848_calculateChargingVoltageTarget, cm848_monitorChargingSystemVoltageHighAndLow, cm848_updateFuelPressureFaultReactionRequests, cm848_applyFuelLimitsForFuelPressureFaults (was cm848_periodicTaskSet_protection3).
cm848_functions.evidence: bl 0xbeb4 is at 0xc378 (frame 8, after 0xb76c 0xb7b4 0xb8fc 0xbb18) and 0xc638 (frame 28, after 0xb76c 0xb7b4 0xb8fc 0xbbb8). No other reference. Body: bl 0x375c8 (0xbec0), 0x37f28 (0xbec4), 0x49df0 (0xbec8), 0x49edc (0xbecc).

cm848_functions.role: Executive frame task set that runs the switch 31 from accelerator pedal logic, the engine retarder cruise permission and the fuel system hardware shutdown monitor once every 20 frames.
cm848_functions.discriminator: Its schedule slot: it is the only set called as call 5 of frames 18 and 38 (the 20-frame slot, phase 18). Its three tasks are unrelated. The set itself has nothing HPCR-specific (all its callees are cm848_), so cm848_ replaces hpcr_.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Executive frame task set: runs every 20 frames (100 ms), at frames 18 and 38 of the 40-frame cycle, as call 5 of those frames in executiveFrameInterruptHandler (the 10-frame slot is empty there). Calls, in order: cm848_updateSwitch31FromAcceleratorPedal, cm848_calculateEngineRetarderCruisePermissionPercent, cm848_monitorFuelSystemHardwareShutdown (was hpcr_periodicTaskSet_protection4).
cm848_functions.evidence: bl 0xc050 is at 0xc4dc (frame 18, after 0xb76c 0xb7b4 0xba08 0xbb68) and 0xc77c (frame 38, after 0xb76c 0xb7b4 0xba08 0xbc08). No other reference. Body: bl 0x2c3c8 (0xc05c), 0x524594 (0xc060), 0x529068 (0xc064).

cm848_functions.role: Converts the lowest torque limit of the derate chain (torque_derate_torque_limit, in lb-ft) into a fuel quantity and applies it to torque_derate_fuel_quantity when it is lower.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It is the only code that turns torque_derate_torque_limit (e2m 1051 +A Torque_Derate_Torque, foot-pounds) into fuel. The fuel is the no-load fuel plus the torque limit times (the 100 percent throttle fueling without programmable power minus the no-load fuel), divided by the maximum torque at the current engine speed. The chain steps before it lower either the torque limit (applyPowerTakeOffTorqueLimit) or the fuel limit itself. There is no rate limit.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Turns torque_derate_torque_limit (e2m 1051 +A Torque_Derate_Torque, lb-ft; 0xffff = none) into a fuel limit: no_load_fuel_quantity + torque_derate_torque_limit x (throttle_100_fueling_without_programmable_power - no_load_fuel_quantity) / the maximum torque at the current engine speed (0x40aee6, forced to at least 1), clamped at 0. When that is below torque_derate_fuel_quantity (105D +0) it becomes the limit, and torque_derate_fuel_source_code takes torque_derate_torque_limit_state (1051 +C). cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling calls it right after cm848_runFuelLimitChains and resets the torque limit to 0xffff / NO_DERATE before that chain. Counterpart of CM550 0x1c0d4, which resets the torque limit itself after the conversion (was cm848_calculateProtectionRateLimited).
cm848_functions.evidence: disasm 0x1e4e8-0x1e5a0. It reads 0x40aee6 (lhz 0x1e504) and stores 1 if it is 0 (sth 0x1e514). It reads 0x40aeec no_load (lhz 0x1e51c), 0x40a2d8 (lhz 0x1e524) and 0x40a89f (lhz 0x1e52c). It multiplies with mulhw / mullw (0x1e534 / 0x1e538) and divides by 0x40aee6 with the 64-bit divide bl 0x570f0 (0x1e54c). It adds no_load (0x1e554) and clamps at 0 (0x1e55c). It compares with 0x40afac (lhz / cmpw 0x1e570), stores 0x40afac (sth 0x1e578) and copies lha 0x40a2da to 0x40afae (0x1e584 / 0x1e588). The only caller is cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling (bl at 0x1e610). Before that call it stores 0xffff to 0x40a2d8 (0x1e5fc) and 40 to 0x40a2da (0x1e608), then calls bl 0x4280c (0x1e60c). e2m records resolved through the parameter ID table: 1051 +A -> 0x40a2d8, 1051 +C -> 0x40a2da, 105D +0 / +2 -> 0x40afac / 0x40afae, 105A +8 Throttle_100_Fueling_No_PP -> 0x40a89f, 109C +0 No_Load_Fuel -> 0x40aeec. The only other writer of 0x40a2d8 is applyPowerTakeOffTorqueLimit (0x2a92c). CM550 0x1c0d4 uses the same formula through jsr 0x35076 (cm550_scaleByRatioSigned), then adds a step: move.w #0xffff,(0x80d338) and move.w #0x28,(0x80d33a) at 0x1c140 / 0x1c148. So it is a counterpart, not a twin; batch L1 names the CM550 side. RAM dump: limit 0xffff with state 40; torque_derate_fuel_quantity 1030 with source 62.

cm848_functions.role: Power-up initialization of the two 2-D lookup caches of the 4D injection timing maps.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It writes only four_dimensional_injection_timing_map_a_cached_axis_offsets and four_dimensional_injection_timing_map_b_cached_axis_offsets (both words = 2). Only cm848_calculateFourDimensionalInjectionTiming uses these caches. Nothing in the body concerns protection or table sizes.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Sets both words of four_dimensional_injection_timing_map_a_cached_axis_offsets and four_dimensional_injection_timing_map_b_cached_axis_offsets to 2 (the first segment). These are the 2-D lookup caches of the two 4D timing maps that cm848_calculateFourDimensionalInjectionTiming blends (e2m 103B Four_D_Timing). Called once from cm848_applicationMain (was cm848_initProtectionTableSizes).
cm848_functions.evidence: disasm 0x1ea6c-0x1ea90: li r3,2; sth to 0x3fa878 and 0x3fa87a (0x1ea78 / 0x1ea7c) and to 0x3fa87c and 0x3fa87e (0x1ea88 / 0x1ea8c); blr. The only caller is cm848_applicationMain (bl at 0x54994, after cm848_selectColdStartFactor). The only reader of the caches is cm848_calculateFourDimensionalInjectionTiming (cpp lines 20891-20915). RAM dump at 0x3fa878: 0002 0002 0002 0002. Naming convention: cm848_initialize<X>LookupCache(s), as in cm848_initializeColdDeltaFuelLookupCache 0x3744c and cm848_initializeCombustionLimitLookupCaches 0x144d0.

cm848_functions.role: Sets point 1 (the idle point) of the J1939 PGN 65251 engine configuration torque curve to the low speed governor reference speed and the derated idle fueling.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It writes only point 1: the speed (e2m 1102 +22) and the fueling (1102 +2C). The speed is low_speed_governor_reference.reference_speed. While low_speed_governor_droop_enable is set and the correction term is nonzero, the LSG droop at the derated idle fueling is subtracted. The fueling is j1939_derated_fueling_at_idle (1104 +A). Its sibling 0x20bfc also sets point 3; 0x21c3c sets the throttle 100 speeds.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Sets point 1 of the J1939 engine configuration torque curve (PGN 65251, e2m 1102) for the derate cases. j1939_torque_curve_speed_at_point_1 (1102 +22 Jcomm_RPM_At_Point_1) = low_speed_governor_reference.reference_speed; while algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal.low_speed_governor_droop_enable is set and governor_integrator_correction_term is nonzero, that term x j1939_derated_fueling_at_idle / 167 is subtracted (a negative result gives 0). j1939_torque_curve_fueling_at_point_1 (1102 +2C) = j1939_derated_fueling_at_idle (1104 +A Jcomm_Derated_Fueling_at_Idle); governor_integrator_correction_term is only ever cleared, so the droop never applies in this build. Called by cm848_updateJ1939EngineConfigurationTorqueCurve (cases 2 and 3) and by cm848_setJ1939TorqueCurvePoints1And3AtDeratedFueling (was cm848_updateProtectionParameters).
cm848_functions.evidence: disasm 0x20b84-0x20bf8. lhz 0x5c352 -> r3 (0x20b88). lhz 0x3fd5b4 masked with 0x40 (0x20b90 / 0x20b94) = low_speed_governor_droop_enable. lha 0x40aeda (0x20ba4). Else branch: lhz 0x40aec2 (0x20bb4). Droop branch: lha 0x40aec2 - (0x40aeda x r3) / 167 (mullw / divw 0x20bc4-0x20bd0), extsh, negative -> 0. sth r4 -> 0x40adac (0x20bec), sth r3 -> 0x40adb6 (0x20bf4). Callers: bl at 0x20c08 (0x20bfc), 0x20e64 and 0x20ef0 (cm848_updateJ1939EngineConfigurationTorqueCurve). e2m: 1102 +22 -> 0x40adac, 1102 +2C -> 0x40adb6, 1104 +A -> 0x5c352 (736 = 50 mm3). 0x40aeda has one store, sth at 0x28b94 (cm848_clearGovernorFilterAccumulators, = 0), and two reads, 0x20ba4 and 0x507a84; RAM dump 0. RAM dump: point 1 speed 6000 = LSG reference 6000.

cm848_functions.role: Sets point 1 (through 0x20b84) and point 3 of the J1939 PGN 65251 torque curve for the derate cases.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It adds point 3 to the point 1 setter. Point 3 takes the derated ROM point 3 (j1939_engine_speed_at_point_3 / j1939_derated_fueling_at_point_3), or point 1's speed and fueling when the point 3 speed is below the point 1 speed.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Runs cm848_setJ1939TorqueCurvePoint1AtDeratedIdleFueling, then sets point 3 of the J1939 engine configuration torque curve (PGN 65251, e2m 1102 +26 / +30). Point 3 takes point 1's speed and fueling when j1939_torque_curve_speed_at_point_3 is below j1939_torque_curve_speed_at_point_1, otherwise j1939_engine_speed_at_point_3 (1104 +4 Jcomm_Engine_Speed_at_Point_3) and j1939_derated_fueling_at_point_3 (1104 +C). Called by cm848_updateJ1939EngineConfigurationTorqueCurve in its cases 6 and 7: a derate while the low speed governor reference is outside its band (was cm848_updateProtectionInputs).
cm848_functions.evidence: disasm 0x20bfc-0x20c60. bl 0x20b84 (0x20c08). It compares lhz 0x40adb0 with lhz 0x40adac (0x20c1c / 0x20c18, cmpw / blt at 0x20c20 / 0x20c24). blt path: sth the point 1 speed -> 0x40adb0 (0x20c40), lhz 0x40adb6 (0x20c48). Else path: lhz 0x5c34c -> sth 0x40adb0 (0x20c2c / 0x20c30), lhz 0x5c354 (0x20c38). Both paths end with sth -> 0x40adba (0x20c50). Callers: bl at 0x20ff4 and 0x21080 in cm848_updateJ1939EngineConfigurationTorqueCurve (cases 6 and 7). e2m: 1102 +26 -> 0x40adb0, 1102 +30 -> 0x40adba, 1104 +4 -> 0x5c34c, 1104 +C -> 0x5c354.

cm848_functions.role: Writes the five J1939 torque curve point speeds of the throttle 100 request unless a higher priority request bit is set.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It is gated by the throttle 100 priority bit (1 << throttle_100_priority_bit_index) against j1939_pgn65251_speed_points_request_flags. It writes all five point speeds, and no fuelings, from the throttle 100 sources: the LSG reference plus an offset, engine_speed_limit_ramped, and 12BD Throttle_Speed_At_Point_3-5. The fault derate request does the same in cm848_calculateFaultDerateJ1939TorqueCurveSpeedPoints.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Sets the five speed points of the J1939 engine configuration torque curve (PGN 65251, e2m 1102 +22 .. +2A) for the throttle 100 request. It returns at once when j1939_pgn65251_speed_points_request_flags (12BB +0 Active_Speed_Points_State) holds a request bit above 1 << throttle_100_priority_bit_index (12BD +A Throttle_100_Priority). Point 1 = low_speed_governor_reference.reference_speed + j1939_pgn65251_speed_at_point_1_low_speed_governor_offset (12BD +0; a negative sum gives 0), point 2 = engine_speed_limit_ramped (the high speed governor speed before droop), points 3 to 5 = j1939_pgn65251_speed_at_point_3 / _4 / _5 (12BD +2 / +4 / +6 Throttle_Speed_At_Point_3-5). Called by cm848_calculateJ1939TorqueCurveFuelingsAndReferenceFuelings after it sets the throttle 100 bit (was cm848_updateProtectionThresholdsIfLow).
cm848_functions.evidence: disasm 0x21c3c-0x21cd0. li 1, slw by lhz 0x5c33e (0x21c44 / 0x21c48), clrlwi 16. lhz 0x40a732, andc with the bit (0x21c54 / 0x21c58), then cmpw / bgt 0x21cd0 (return). Point 1: lhz 0x40aec2 + lha 0x5c334 (0x21c68 / 0x21c70), negative -> 0, sth 0x40adac (0x21c8c). Point 2: lhz 0x40a308 -> sth 0x40adae (0x21c98 / 0x21c9c). Points 3-5: 0x5c336 -> 0x40adb0, 0x5c338 -> 0x40adb2, 0x5c33a -> 0x40adb4 (0x21ca8-0x21ccc). The only caller is bl at 0x21d4c (cm848_calculateJ1939TorqueCurveFuelingsAndReferenceFuelings), after it ORs throttle_100_speed_points_request_bit into 0x40a732. e2m: 12BB +0 -> 0x40a732; 12BD +0 / +2 / +4 / +6 / +A -> 0x5c334 / 0x5c336 / 0x5c338 / 0x5c33a / 0x5c33e. RAM dump: request flags 0x80 (bit 7 = throttle_100_priority_bit_index 7), point 1 speed 6000.

cm848_functions.role: Power-up initialization of the engine retarder TSC1 request state and of the retarder stage quantizer.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It writes the retarder TSC1 request words (torque limit 100, override control mode off, control device none), the retarder stage count (the sum of the six engine brake driver cylinder counts) and the five stage table lookup caches. resetEngineRetarderTsc1Request (0x27118) only ends a request (limit 125, timers cleared) and sets up no stage data.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Power-up initialization of the engine retarder TSC1 path (TSC1 frames addressed to the engine retarder, handled by cm848_processEngineRetarderTsc1Request). It sets engine_retarder_torque_limit_percent = 100, engine_retarder_override_control_mode = TSC1_OVERRIDE_OFF, engine_retarder_control_device_indicator = J1939_CONTROL_DEVICE_NONE (e2m 10E6 +2) and engine_retarder_stage_count = the sum of engine_retarder_driver_1..6_cylinder_count (e2m 13D8; 1 here). It sets the five stage table lookup caches engine_retarder_torque_stage_1..5_cached_axis_offset of cm848_selectEngineRetarderStagePercent to 2. Called by cm848_j1939_system_init after the ERC1 and retarder configuration buffers are set up (was cm848_initGovernorProtectionState).
cm848_functions.evidence: disasm 0x23a9c-0x23b34: li 100 -> sth 0x40ad62 (0x23aa4); li 0 -> sth 0x40ad5a (0x23ab0) and 0x40ad5c (0x23ab8); lhz 0x5c47e + 0x5c480 + 0x5c482 + 0x5c484 + 0x5c486 + 0x5c488 (0x23ac4-0x23b00) -> sth 0x3faa72 (0x23b04); li 2 -> 0x3faa7a / 7c / 7e / 80 / 82 (0x23b10-0x23b30). The only caller is bl at 0x539278 in cm848_j1939_system_init, after cm848_initializePgn61440ElectronicRetarderController1Buffer and cm848_initializePgn65249RetarderConfigurationBuffer. Readers: cm848_selectEngineRetarderStagePercent (the stage count == 4 test and the five caches) and cm848_applyEngineRetarderTsc1Request (the torque limit). RAM dump: 0x40ad62 = 100, 0x3faa72 = 1, override 0, device 0.

cm848_functions.role: Power-up initialization of the misfire timing limit: its lookup cache, its output and the main timing before the limit.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It writes only the state of the misfire timing limit (e2m 8A3D): the cache of cm848_calculateInjectionTimingMainMisfireLimit (2 / 2), injection_timing_main_misfire_limit (8A3D +0) = 0 and 0x40aeea (8A3D +2 SOI_Before_MST) = 0. The body has no filter, no accumulator and no PID.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Power-up initialization of the misfire timing limit (e2m 8A3D). It sets both words of injection_timing_main_misfire_limit_cached_axis_offsets (the 2-D lookup cache of cm848_calculateInjectionTimingMainMisfireLimit) to 2. It clears injection_timing_main_misfire_limit (8A3D +0 Misfire_Timing_Limit) and main_injection_timing_before_misfire_limit (8A3D +2 SOI_Before_MST, 'desired SOI before being limited by misfire algorithm'). Called once from cm848_applicationMain (was cm848_initProtectionFilterAccumulators).
cm848_functions.evidence: disasm 0x29e24-0x29e4c: li 2; sth 0x3fafa6 (0x29e30) and 0x3fafa4 (0x29e34); li 0; sth 0x40aeea (0x29e40) and 0x40aee8 (0x29e48). The only caller is cm848_applicationMain (bl at 0x54a64). e2m through the parameter ID table: 8A3D +0 Misfire_Timing_Limit -> 0x40aee8, 8A3D +2 SOI_Before_MST -> 0x40aeea. cm848_functions.role: Power-up initialization of the all-speed governor tuning set blend weight from its EEPROM default.
cm848_functions.discriminator: One step: it copies governor_tuning_set_default_blend_weight_cal (EEPROM 0xa4, e2m 1387 +8 ASG_Droop_Flag_Trim) into governor_tuning_set_blend_weight. The only other writer of that word is cm848_blendAllSpeedGovernorReferenceSpeeds.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Copies governor_tuning_set_default_blend_weight_cal (EEPROM 0xa4, e2m 1387 +8 ASG_Droop_Flag_Trim 'select droop source') into governor_tuning_set_blend_weight. That word is the 0..128 weight between the all-speed governor's two tuning sets; cm848_blendAllSpeedGovernorReferenceSpeeds later picks it from drivetrain_ratio. Called once from cm848_applicationMain (was cm848_initProtectionLimitVariables).
cm848_functions.evidence: disasm 0x2c100-0x2c110: lhz 0x3fd526 (0x2c108) -> sth 0x40af7c (0x2c10c); blr. The only caller is cm848_applicationMain (bl at 0x54a1c). e2m: 1387 +8 -> EEPROM 0xa4 = 0x3fd526. Writers of 0x40af7c: this function and cm848_blendAllSpeedGovernorReferenceSpeeds (0x2bf6c). Readers: the governor tuning blends (cpp lines 10290-10409 and 48373-48400). RAM dump 0x40af7c = 128.

cm848_functions.role: Power-up initialization of the state of the fuel pressure governor fault blend (step 13 of the fuel limit chain).
cm848_functions.discriminator: It writes only the state words of cm848_applyFuelPressureGovernorFaultBlend: its lookup cache (2), the blend output and the blend start fuel (5888 = 400 mm3, no limit) and the blend fraction (0).
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Power-up initialization of cm848_applyFuelPressureGovernorFaultBlend (fueling state 62): safety_fuel_limit_cached_axis_offset = 2, safety_fuel_blend_output and safety_blend_fuel_demand_prev = 5888 (400 mm3, no limit), safety_fuel_blend_fraction = 0. Called once from cm848_applicationMain (was cm848_initProtectionFilterLimits).
cm848_functions.evidence: disasm 0x38a98-0x38ac4: li 2 -> sth 0x3fb3c2 (0x38aa0); li 5888 -> sth 0x40b31e (0x38aac) and 0x40b320 (0x38ab4); li 0 -> sth 0x40b322 (0x38ac0). cm848_functions.role: Stores the 32-bit value 5 at 0x3fb500 in the transmission_type_cal 3 branch of the torque management requirement check. That branch never runs.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It makes the only access to 0x3fb500 in ROM and flash2 (a 32-bit store of 5). Its only caller is the transmission_type_cal == 3 branch of cm848_evaluateTorqueManagementRequired. The body has nothing thermal in it.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Stores 5 as a 32-bit word in torque_management_transmission_type_3_code (0x3fb500, next to torque_management_gear_ratio_stage) for transmission_type_cal 3. That is the one branch of cm848_evaluateTorqueManagementRequired that sets neither the required flag nor the stage. cm848_functions.role: Runs the derate fuel limit chain that produces torque_derate_fuel_quantity / torque_derate_fuel_source_code and the group 2 minimum.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It is the 13-step chain: first the seven steps shared with CM550 (initializeFuelLimitChains .. applyFuelSystemDerateFuelLimit) in the same order, then six CM848 limiters (coolant overheat, torque management, rpm and demand, net torque, rail pressure shortfall, fuel pressure governor fault blend). Counterpart of cm550_runFuelLimitChains.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Runs the fuel limit chains that produce torque_derate_fuel_quantity / torque_derate_fuel_source_code (e2m 105D +0 / +2) and the group 2 minimum fuel_demand_minimum_tracked (105D +6 / +8). The steps, with their fueling state codes: initializeFuelLimitChains (19 / 40), applyPowerTakeOffTorqueLimit (34), applyAirFuelControlFuelLimit (16), applyAltitudeDerateFuelLimit (15), applyFaultDerateFuelLimit (29), applyTsc1TorqueLimit (20), applyFuelSystemDerateFuelLimit (28), cm848_applyCoolantOverheatFuelDerate (46), cm848_applyTorqueManagementFuelLimit (45), cm848_applyFuelLimitByRpmAndDemand (42), cm848_applyNetTorqueFuelLimit (59), cm848_limitFuelQuantityOnRailPressureShortfall (61), cm848_applyFuelPressureGovernorFaultBlend (62). Called by cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling before cm848_convertTorqueDerateTorqueLimitToFuelLimit. Counterpart of cm550_runFuelLimitChains (0x30c3c): the same seven shared steps in the same order, without CM550's steps 17 / 33 and with six newer limiters (was cm848_processProtectionLimits).

cm848_functions.role: Power-up initialization of the debounced switch inputs: the default states, one input line snapshot and four scan-and-debounce passes.
cm848_functions.discriminator: It is the only code that seeds switch_input_state_bits from the ROM defaults and then runs cm848_scanAndDebounceSwitchInputs four times in a row after one cm848_refreshInputLineImage, which fills the 4-sample debounce. Nothing in it concerns protection or outputs, and nothing is HPCR-specific, so cm848_ replaces hpcr_.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Power-up initialization of the logical switch inputs. It copies the 4 bytes of j1939_switch_input_default_state_bits (ROM, all 0) into switch_input_state_bits, takes one input line snapshot (cm848_refreshInputLineImage) and runs cm848_scanAndDebounceSwitchInputs 4 times, so the 4-sample debounce starts from the real line states. Called once from cm848_applicationMain before the sensor channel initializers (was hpcr_initProtectionAndOutputCycle).

The cm848_scanAndDebounceSwitchInputs plate describes a 4-sample debounce (all 4 set -> set, all 4 clear -> clear, else hold) into switch_input_state_bits.

cm848_functions.role: Calculates the percent load on the low horsepower torque curve (e2m 10BF +4 Tau_0_Percent_Load).
cm848_functions.discriminator: Its only output is engine_load_low_horsepower_curve_percent (10BF +4 SPT0PCLD): (final_fueling - no_load) x 25600 / (throttle_100_fueling_low_horsepower_curve - no_load), clamped at 0xff00, and 0 unless both fuelings are above the no-load fuel. Nothing in it concerns timing or validation.
cm848_functions.plate_comment: Percent load on the low horsepower torque curve (e2m 10BF +4 Tau_0_Percent_Load [SPT0PCLD], 1/256 percent), every 100 ms from cm848_periodicTaskGroup28_calibration10, right after cm848_calculateEngineLoadPercentages. When final_fueling (1051 +0) and throttle_100_fueling_low_horsepower_curve (105A +2 FST0MXFL) are both above no_load_fuel_quantity (109C +0) it stores (final_fueling - no_load) x 25600 / (the low horsepower curve fueling - no_load), clamped at 0xff00; otherwise it stores 0. Counterpart of cm550_calculateEngineLoadLowHorsepowerCurvePercent (0x26e2c), which compares unsigned and does not clamp (was cm848_validateFuelDemandRelativeToTiming).

proposal.notes:
Scratch notes and scripts are in /home/linux/.claude/jobs/374b0424/tmp/w15/r94/scratch/L4/investigator/ (notes.md, slots.py, findptr.py, whichfunc.py, ppcrefs.py, baserefs.py).
Judgment calls:
(1) All four task sets take the CM550 round 93 slot names (cm848_runEvery<N>FramesTaskSetPhase<M>), including 0xbce8, which has a single task, because CM550 named its single-task sets by slot too. The other CM848 task sets keep role names, some of them wrong (cm848_periodicTaskSet_canTx calls no CAN transmit), or meaningless group numbers (cm848_periodicTaskGroup<N>_calibration<M>). Lead: rename them all by slot. 8-frame slot: canTx 0 / sensors2 1 / timing 3 / outputs 4 / sensors 5 / monitoring 6 / communication 7. 10-frame slot: Group12..15 = phases 0..3, Group17 = 5, Group18 = 6; phases 7..9 are empty. 20-frame slot: Group25..32 = phases 0..7, auxiliary 9, periodicTaskSet_fuelDemand 10, Group36..38 = 11..13, diagnostics2 14, Group20..22 = 15..17, outputs2 19. 4-frame slot: fuelFinal 0 / sensorProcessing 1 / controlLoop 2 / auxiliaryControl 3.
(2) For 0x1e4e8, batch L1 decides the CM550 relation. L1's notes reach the same conclusion: counterpart, because CM550 0x1c0d4 resets the torque limit at its end. If L1 agrees, the same base name with the cm550_ prefix would pair the two.
(3) 0x3eccc gets a descriptive name, with medium confidence, for code that is unreachable under any calibration. The meaning of the value 5 is unknown.
Leads:
- Code at 0x29ecc-0x29f38 is not in function_renames and nothing calls it (no bl, no pointer). It applies the misfire timing limit to 103B +2 SOI, writes SOI_Before_MST and stores intermediate source 11 (e2m 103B label 0B MISFIRE). INJECTION_TIMING_INTERMEDIATE_SOURCE has no member 11.
- cm848_calculateFuelDemandFilter (0x29c98) and cm848_initFuelDemandFilterDimensions (0x29de0) are misnamed: they compute and initialize the maximum torque at the current engine speed (MT_Max_Torque_Map), with no fuel demand filter.
- 0x40aeda governor_integrator_correction_term is only ever cleared (0x28b94) and read (0x20ba4, 0x507a84), so the LSG droop correction of the torque curve point 1 never applies.
- The fault blend globals 0x40b31e / 0x40b320 / 0x40b322 / 0x40b324 / 0x40b326 (safety_*; 'prev' is an abbreviation) could take fuel_pressure_governor_fault_blend_* names.
- Comments that still use the old names need a text sweep after the renames: global_variables.csv rows for 0x3faa72, 0x3faa7a, 0x3fd526, 0x40a2d8, 0x40a2da, 0x40adac, 0x40adb6, 0x40afac, 0x40c04a, 0x5c34c, 0x5c352, 0x5c334, 0x5c336; structure_definitions.csv lines 1853 and 2070; the function_renames.csv header line 19 (CM848D periodicTaskSet_protection <-> CM550 periodicTaskSet_governorProtection); the plates of 0x20d10, 0x21cd4, 0x3f2b0, 0x49df0, 0x533e0 and 0x538a84.
None of the batch functions owns a protection_* global.

roles.role: Turns the torque derate torque limit into a fuel limit and folds it into the derate minimum. If the maximum torque at the current speed (0x40aee6) is 0 it sets it to 1. Then fuel = no_load_fuel_quantity (e2m 109C +0) + torque_derate_torque_limit (1051 +A TQDQTQ, lb-ft) x (throttle_100_fueling_without_programmable_power (105A +8) - no_load_fuel_quantity) / that maximum torque, using a signed 64/32 divide (cm848_signedDivision32), with a floor at 0. When the result is below torque_derate_fuel_quantity (105D +0 FSLMFL), it is stored there with torque_derate_fuel_source_code = torque_derate_torque_limit_state (1051 +C).
roles.discriminator: It is the only derate step that converts a TORQUE (lb-ft) into fuel: a straight line from the friction fuel at 0 torque to the full-throttle fuel at the maximum torque for this speed. It is also the only one that copies its source code from torque_derate_torque_limit_state. The chain steps in 0x4280c fold ready-made fuel limits with fixed codes, and applyPowerTakeOffTorqueLimit only lowers the torque limit that this function converts. Its only caller is cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling 0x1e5a4 (when torque_derate_override_enable = 0), which presets the torque limit to 0xffff / NO_DERATE, runs 0x4280c and then this function. The code has no rate limit and no protection.
roles.cm848_counterpart: CM848 function itself. CM550 cm550_FUN_0001c0d4 @ 0x1c0d4 is a COUNTERPART, not a twin. It uses the same formula (cm550_scaleByRatioSigned, with 0x80db1a = e2m 1461 +0 MTMPRPFL, max torque at current rpm) and the same min-fold, but it also resets torque_derate_torque_limit to 0xffff / NO_DERATE at its end. CM848 does that reset in its caller before the chain. Batch L1 owns the CM550 side.

roles.role: Writes 2 (first segment) into both words of four_dimensional_injection_timing_map_a_cached_axis_offsets (0x3fa878) and four_dimensional_injection_timing_map_b_cached_axis_offsets (0x3fa87c) (asm: li r3,2 plus four sth). These are the lookup caches of the two 4D timing maps that only cm848_calculateFourDimensionalInjectionTiming (0x1e870) interpolates. cm848_applicationMain calls it once, at boot.

roles.cm848_counterpart: CM848 function itself. CM550: none found (no 4D timing map caches in its globals).

roles.role: Sets point 1 (the idle point) of the J1939 PGN 65251 engine configuration torque curve. The speed j1939_torque_curve_speed_at_point_1 (e2m 1102 +22 Jcomm_RPM_At_Point_1, 'LSG Reference') = low_speed_governor_reference.reference_speed. When algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal.low_speed_governor_droop_enable is set and the droop term 0x40aeda is nonzero, it subtracts (term x j1939_derated_fueling_at_idle) / 167 and clamps at 0. The fueling j1939_torque_curve_fueling_at_point_1 (1102 +2C) = j1939_derated_fueling_at_idle (1104 +A JCDQFLIS, 'fueling at idle ... when torque derate').
roles.discriminator: It writes only point 1, from the derated idle fueling. cm848_setJ1939TorqueCurvePoints2And5AtDroopLineFueling (0x20c64) writes points 2/5. cm848_calculateFaultDerateJ1939TorqueCurveSpeedPoints (0x507a20) computes the same droop-adjusted speed with the fault derate intercept fueling. Callers: cm848_updateJ1939EngineConfigurationTorqueCurve 0x20d10, cases 2 / 3 (altitude or air fuel control derate), and through 0x20bfc in cases 6 / 7. Nothing protective.
roles.cm848_counterpart: CM848 function itself. CM550: not identified.

roles.role: Calls 0x20b84 (point 1) and then sets point 3 of the J1939 PGN 65251 torque curve. If the current point 3 speed (0x40adb0) is below the new point 1 speed (0x40adac), point 3 takes point 1's speed and fueling. Otherwise point 3 = j1939_engine_speed_at_point_3 (e2m 1104 +4) and j1939_derated_fueling_at_point_3 (1104 +C) (asm 0x20c08-0x20c50).
roles.discriminator: It is the only function that sets points 1 and 3 together, with the 'point 3 not below point 1' rule. cm848_updateJ1939EngineConfigurationTorqueCurve calls it in cases 6 / 7 (low speed governor reference outside its idle band plus an altitude or air fuel control derate), and in cases 2 / 3 it calls 0x20b84 alone.
roles.cm848_counterpart: CM848 function itself. CM550: not identified.

roles.role: When no request bit higher than the throttle 100 bit (1 << throttle_100_priority_bit_index, e2m 12BD +A Throttle_100_Priority) is set in j1939_pgn65251_speed_points_request_flags (e2m 12BB +0), it writes all five J1939 torque curve SPEEDS. Point 1 = LSG reference speed + j1939_pgn65251_speed_at_point_1_low_speed_governor_offset (12BD +0), clamped at 0. Point 2 = engine_speed_limit_ramped. Points 3/4/5 = Throttle_Speed_At_Point_3..5 (12BD +2/+4/+6). It writes no fuelings.
roles.discriminator: It is the throttle 100 source of the PGN 65251 speed points. Its priority-gated sibling for the fault derate source is cm848_calculateFaultDerateJ1939TorqueCurveSpeedPoints (0x507a20). Its only caller is cm848_calculateJ1939TorqueCurveFuelingsAndReferenceFuelings 0x21cd4, which runs it while programmable_power_enable = 0, after it sets the throttle 100 bit. The 'IfLow' in the old name is this priority test. No thresholds and no protection.
roles.cm848_counterpart: CM848 function itself. CM550: not identified.

roles.role: Start-up initialization of the engine retarder TSC1 request and stage selection. It sets engine_retarder_torque_limit_percent = 100, engine_retarder_override_control_mode = TSC1_OVERRIDE_OFF and engine_retarder_control_device_indicator = J1939_CONTROL_DEVICE_NONE. It sets engine_retarder_stage_count = the sum of engine_retarder_driver_1..6_cylinder_count (e2m 13D8 Jcomm_EB_Driver_n_Num_Cyl) and writes 2 into engine_retarder_torque_stage_1..5_cached_axis_offset. Called once at boot: cm848_applicationMain -> cm848_initCanHardware -> cm848_j1939_system_init.

No governor and no protection.

It writes 2 into both words of injection_timing_main_misfire_limit_cached_axis_offsets (0x3fafa4) and 0 into 0x40aeea (e2m 8A3D +2 SOI_Before_MST) and into injection_timing_main_misfire_limit (0x40aee8, 8A3D +0 Misfire_Timing_Limit) (asm 0x29e24-0x29e4c).
